_comment: Schema boundary allowlist (V531). Entries are EXISTING bare cross-schema references that predate the gate; each must state why it is allowed. New violations outside this list block CI. Format: "svc/file" -> reason. This file is the PER-FILE baseline for the NODE gate (scripts/ci/check-schema-boundary.cjs, bare sqlx::query* call sites only). The PYTHON gate (scripts/check_schema_boundary.py) uses a DIFFERENT model — per-service schema ownership — and reads scripts/schema_boundary.json; the two are complementary, not duplicates. Temporary entries below are mirrored in schema_boundary.json and MUST be revoked together after stage-2.
